semantics.title: A wait needs an effective deadline
semantics.mechanism: An unbounded readiness wait can retain a request indefinitely when the worker never becomes ready.
semantics.invariant: A readiness wait must have an effective local or propagated deadline.
applicability: Readiness waits whose completion is not guaranteed by the API contract
exceptions: An outer deadline demonstrably propagates cancellation to this wait
requiredContext: Caller deadline and cancellation propagation contract
semantics.expectedBehavior: Confirm that expiry terminates the pending wait; if caller context is missing, return Unknown.
